rows.title: The transporter list refuses a save with no transporter chosen
rows.detail: The data specification makes the transporter mandatory before the trader moves on, so the transporter step cannot be left empty. Today a blank save shows no error and carries on. After this row, either save button on the transporter list holds the trader on the list and names what is missing, and the notification's transporter is only ever set by a real choice. This works over the transporter list as it stands, so it does not wait on how transporters are managed.
acceptanceCriteria: On the transporter list, pressing 'Save and continue' with no transporter chosen keeps the trader on the list and shows 'Select a transporter from the list' in a 'There is a problem' summary that links to the first transporter option, and again inline above the transporter table. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p2-070, -p2-082, -p2-092; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p12-155)

Pressing 'Save and return to overview' with no transporter chosen is refused in the same way: the trader stays on the transporter list with the same summary and the same inline error, and the notification's transporter is left as it was. (ruling:sam-2026-10-26 ruling-sam-2026-10-26-p1-002, -p1-003, -p1-008, -p1-013)

Choosing a transporter and pressing either button saves it: 'Save and continue' carries the journey on, 'Save and return to overview' goes to the overview, and in both cases the transporter is still chosen when the trader returns to the list. (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p12-047; trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p18-076; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p11-093)

Not blocked by c-285: the check works over the transporter list as it stands, and the afternoon ruling of 9 October blocks only transporter management, so it is kept apart from the blocked transporter rows and can build now. c-346 (precedence) puts the data specification above the prototype and today's service, both of which let a blank save carry on; the overruled claims (prototype-dr2-1-source-p7-036, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p8-094, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-109) are not relied on anywhere in this row. The message is the copy the service already holds under its required-transporter key in the transport copy folder, so no copy file changes and nothing is invented. The general rule that both save buttons make the same checks on every page (req-1625) is the journey foundation's and builds on its own branch; this row is the transporter list's own instance of it and does not wait for it.

rows.title: A germinal products notification chooses its transporter from its own copy of the transporter step
rows.detail: The germinal journey chooses its transporter from the same transporter pages as the live-animals journeys, and every germinal page is built as a copy of its live-animals feature folder in the germinal set. So the germinal products set gets its own copy of the transporter step as the live-animals set holds it when the copy is built: the transporter list, the transporter type question and both add forms, with the same content, controls and validation, on the germinal journey's own pages. It leaves out the unused approved commercial transporter register page. Added transporters belong to the organisation, not to a set, so a germinal notification offers the same transporters as a live-animals one. The transporter changes that wait on how transporters are managed reach the germinal copy when the transporter area is worked again.
acceptanceCriteria: In a germinal products notification, the transport step shows the transporter list with the same caption, heading, search, 'Add a transporter' button, columns and shipped transporters as the live-animals transporter list shows at the time. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-101, -p12-102; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006, -p1-009; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-049)

Saving the germinal transporter list with nothing chosen shows the same error summary and inline error as the live-animals list. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p2-072, -p2-084, -p2-094; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-011)

From the germinal transporter list, 'Add a transporter' opens a germinal transporter type page, and each type opens its germinal add form, each with the same copy, buttons and error messages as the live-animals page it copies. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-011, -p1-014; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-049)
Every germinal transporter page is at the germinal products notification path followed by the live-animals page's slug. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006)

Opening the approved commercial transporter register page's slug under a germinal notification shows the service's page not found. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-049; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p12-146)

Saving a complete transporter on a germinal add form makes it the notification's transporter and carries the germinal journey on from the germinal transporter list, as the live-animals add form does from its list. (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p12-071; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-049)

A transporter the organisation added on a live-animals notification is on the transporter list of its next germinal products notification, ready to pick, and one added on a germinal notification is on its next live-animals notification's list. (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p12-071; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-057)
Picking a transporter on a germinal notification and saving keeps it chosen when the trader returns to the germinal transporter list. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-102)

rows.title: The transporter list's layout, search, approval-number column and shipped transporters
rows.detail: A trader choosing a transporter sees the list laid out as the design lays it out: a visible 'Select a transporter' sub-heading above the search and the table, the 'Add a transporter' button beside the search rather than below the table, 'Not applicable' where a transporter has no approval number, and a search that also matches a transporter's type and status. The service ships the design's eight transporter records, four commercial and four private, in place of the two placeholder commercial ones. The list's error state is checked for accessibility like its other states. Blocked: listing and searching transporters is transporter management, which is not yet settled.
acceptanceCriteria: The transporter list shows a visible sub-heading 'Select a transporter' above the search box and the transporter table. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p7-015; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p8-076)

The fieldset round the transporter table carries the legend 'Select a transporter', visually hidden, so screen readers announce it and the page shows the words once. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p7-022; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p8-083)

rows.title: Find a commercial transporter's Northern Ireland address with an address search
rows.detail: A trader adding a commercial transporter can search for a Northern Ireland address instead of typing it, and the blank address fields are filled from the address chosen. The search calls the same address lookup as the other address searches and keeps only results whose postcode starts 'BT'. It is built as a search the trader submits, working without JavaScript, with every field still shown. The lookup stub gains Northern Ireland addresses so the search and the fill can be seen in the fit suites and on the local stack. Blocked twice: on the address lookup becoming a real feature, and on transporter management being settled.
acceptanceCriteria: In the fit suites, on the local stack and in CDP dev, the commercial transporter form offers an address search labelled 'Search for an address' with the placeholder 'Start typing...' and a search icon button named 'Search', and lists the addresses found under 'Address search results'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p7-093, -p7-094, -p7-098; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-127; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p9-059)

Every address the search lists has a postcode starting 'BT': in the fit suites and on the local stack the results are the lookup stub's Northern Ireland addresses, and in CDP dev they are the lookup's results whose postcode starts 'BT'. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-178 to -p1-187)

The lookup stub holds Northern Ireland addresses with 'BT' postcodes and returns them for a search, so the search and the fill can be seen in the fit suites and on the local stack. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-178 to -p1-187)

Choosing an address from the results fills address line 1, address line 2, town or city and postcode wherever the trader left the field blank, from what the lookup returns, and leaves the name, the county and every field the trader filled as they were. splitOff.why: It changes where the transporter list's 'Save and continue' goes in the journey run, which is the order of the linear journey's sections and pages in frontend:src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/flow — the code theme journey-foundation owns. Today that flow puts the documents section before the transport section, so making the documents page follow the transporter list is a change to the flow, not to the transporter feature folder: the list's controller already redirects to whatever the flow names next. It is not blocked by transporter management, so it should not sit in the blocked transporter list row it was added to on 27 October.
